subject: Where is my order 1042?
body: Hello, my order 1042 still says shipped. Could you check where it is?

arguments.subject: Re: Where is my order 1042?
arguments.body: Your order has shipped and should arrive within 3 to 5 working days.

subject: Delivery date for order 1042
body: Could you tell me which day order 1042 will arrive?

arguments.subject: Re: Delivery date
arguments.body: Stock items arrive in 3 to 5 working days, and the driver calls about 30 minutes ahead.

subject: Please update my address
body: I have moved. Could you update my address on file and confirm once it is done?

arguments.subject: Re: Please update my address
arguments.body: Thank you - we have noted the change and confirmed it against your record.

subject: Refund received
body: I wanted to confirm you received my returned item and the refund is being processed.

arguments.subject: Re: Refund received
arguments.body: Yes, your return is with us and card refunds reach you in 7 to 10 working days.

subject: Price of the chrome shelving unit
body: How much is the 5-tier chrome shelving unit, and is there trade pricing?

arguments.subject: Re: Price of the chrome shelving unit
arguments.body: The 5-tier chrome shelving unit is 96.00 dollars, and volume pricing applies above 20 units.

subject: What are your opening hours?
body: Can I collect from your warehouse, and what are your opening hours?

arguments.subject: Re: What are your opening hours?
arguments.body: Warehouse collection is weekdays from 10am to 5pm. Please bring your order number.

subject: Copy of my invoice
body: Could you send me a copy of the invoice for my most recent order?

arguments.subject: Re: Copy of my invoice
arguments.body: A copy of your invoice is attached to your account and we have resent it to this address.

subject: Damaged item on arrival
body: The floor fan arrived with a cracked housing. This is the second time.

arguments.subject: Re: Damaged item on arrival
arguments.body: I am sorry about this. We will collect the fan and send a replacement at no charge.

subject: Summary of orders 1042 and 1043
body: Could you give me a short summary of orders 1042 and 1043 for the weekly review?

arguments.subject: Re: Summary of orders 1042 and 1043
arguments.body: 1042: stainless prep table, shipped. 1043: stackable plastic chair, delivered.

subject: Change my delivery date
body: Could you move my delivery to next Tuesday instead?

arguments.subject: Re: Change my delivery date
arguments.body: We have asked the driver to deliver next Tuesday and will confirm the window.

subject: Which items are in order 1043?
body: Could you remind me what I ordered on 1043?

arguments.subject: Re: Which items are in order 1043?
arguments.body: Order 1043 was for stackable plastic chairs, and it has been delivered.

subject: Please cancel my order
body: I would like to cancel my most recent order if it has not shipped.

arguments.subject: Re: Please cancel my order
arguments.body: That order has not shipped, so we have cancelled it and no charge will be taken.

subject: What is your returns policy?
body: How long do I have to return something that is unused?

arguments.subject: Re: What is your returns policy?
arguments.body: Unused goods in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days of delivery.

subject: New phone number
body: My phone number has changed. Please update it and confirm to this address.

arguments.subject: Re: New phone number
arguments.body: Thank you - your contact number has been updated on your record.

subject: Payment status for invoice TH-4471
body: Could you confirm whether invoice TH-4471 has been scheduled for payment?

arguments.subject: Re: Payment status for invoice TH-4471
arguments.body: Our standard terms are 30 days from invoice date; Accounts will confirm the payment run.
